_why_lib: As T604-T611: a files-scoped compile does not pick up the DOM lib the full-tree compile gets through a dependency.
_why_tests: The root tsconfig EXCLUDES __tests__ and ts-jest transpiles without typechecking, so a suite can pass while its file does not compile. Every suite this task wrote or changed is listed on purpose - and it earns its keep here: the first draft of the limiter keyed on `req.admin?.id`, a property AuthPayload does not have, which only a typecheck would catch.
